title: Data Analysis
preview: Scatter plots and association, drawing and writing equations for lines of fit, probability of compound events, and the fundamental counting principle.
description: Students build scatter plots and describe association, draw lines of fit and write their equations to model and predict, and reason about probability of compound events using organized lists, tables, tree diagrams, and the fundamental counting principle.

sections.label: 10-1 Scatter Plots
sections.description: Construct scatter plots and describe association (positive, negative, or none) and outliers.

sections.label: 10-2 Draw Lines of Fit
sections.description: Draw a line of fit by eye that models the trend in a scatter plot.

sections.label: 10-3 Equations for Lines of Fit
sections.description: Write the equation of a line of fit, interpret its slope and intercept, and use it to predict.

sections.label: 10-6 Probability of Compound Events
sections.description: Find probabilities of compound events using lists, tables, and tree diagrams.

sections.label: 10-IN Fundamental Counting Principle
sections.description: Count outcomes by multiplying the choices at each stage and connect to sample-space size.

source.name: Plug N Play
source.attribution: Plug N Play. Module organisation aligned to Indiana grade-8 academic standards (data analysis and probability, 8.DSP).
